status: engine core + rules loader + engine tests link for m68k-amigaos 68040/FPU and run in FS-UAE/AROS 68040 with output byte-identical to the host sanitizer build
scope: engine/*.cpp, engine/stubs/*.cpp with engine/tests/engine_test.cpp and engine/tests/wp0b_test.cpp; synthetic fixtures from test_engine.py and test_engine_wp0b.py only (no original assets)

cause.symptom: final link fails: libstdc++.a(eh_globals.o), libstdc++.a(guard.o), libgcc.a(unwind-dw2.o, unwind-dw2-fde.o) have undefined pthread_key_create, pthread_once, pthread_getspecific, pthread_setspecific, pthread_key_delete, pthread_mutex_lock, pthread_mutex_unlock, pthread_cancel
cause.chain: the engine uses std::string, std::map, std::unordered_map and operator new; string-inst.o, hashtable and new_op reference std::__throw_* (functexcept.o) and __cxa_begin_catch (eh_catch.o) because libstdc++ itself is built with exceptions; these pull eh_globals.o, eh_throw.o, eh_personality.o and the unwinder, which the toolchain built for POSIX threads with direct (not weak) pthread_* calls. -fno-exceptions and -fno-rtti on our sources cannot remove these archive members; -fno-threadsafe-statics only removes guard.o.
cause.whyNotStubs: a single-threaded __cxa_get_globals would still leave unwind-dw2/unwind-dw2-fde needing pthread_mutex_*/pthread_once/pthread_cancel; stubbing all of them means shadowing toolchain runtime internals in engine code.

fix.change: add -pthread to the default m68k-amigaos flags
fix.effect: the toolchain spec turns -pthread into -lpthread inside its own -( libc -lamiga -lgcc -lpthread -) link group; no thread is created by the engine
fix.runtime: default C runtime of the other Alpha native build scripts (no -noixemul, no -mcrt)

toolchains.beforeFix: both fail the link with the pthread_* undefined references above

arosValidation.machine: FS-UAE 3.2.35, A1200, 68040/FPU, 64 MiB motherboard RAM, AROS m68k 20261027

comparison.host: g++ -std=c++17 -O1 -g -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-sanitize-recover=all, same commands from the same relative paths
comparison.arosVsHost: stdout+RC log byte-identical (873581 bytes); all 37 written SAV/daemon files byte-identical; same set of files written
